name: Eidolon: Laws of Ruin
source:
In a galaxy ruled by eight merciless cosmic laws known as the Principles, every world bends beneath a Path: creation, destruction, unity, survival, power, restraint, release, and finality. These laws do not care about good or evil. They only enforce what they believe reality must become.

Then the Novasphere Space Program discovers something impossible drifting in dead space. A sealed wolf named Ardent Cruzq awakens with no memory of who he truly is...

Taken in by a crew of explorers, engineers, outcasts, and dreamers, Ardent travels across broken worlds shaped by impossible beliefs. Each planet offers wonder, danger, and a question no one can answer safely: Can something born from ruin choose a better path?

Y-- a-e w--- was ---- b-h--d. 

[From [url=https://lyricalverse.itch.io/lawsofruin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个由八个无情的宇宙法则（称为“原则”）统治的星系中，每个世界都遵循一条路径：创造、毁灭、统一、生存、权力、限制、释放和终结。这些法律不关心善恶。他们只强制执行他们认为现实必须成为的样子。

然后，新星圈太空计划发现了一些不可能的东西在死亡空间中漂流。一只名叫热心·克鲁兹克的封印狼苏醒后，不记得自己到底是谁……

热心被一群探险家、工程师、流浪者和梦想家收留，穿越了由不可能的信仰塑造的支离破碎的世界。每颗星球都充满奇迹、危险，以及一个无人能安全回答的问题：从废墟中诞生的东西能否选择更好的道路？

Y-- a-e w--- 是 ---- b-h--d。

[来自[url=https://lyricalverse.itch.io/lawsofruin]Itch.io[/url]]
